servinfo.title: BCM Registration
servinfo.ptxt: After BCM is replaced with new one, register remote controller ID code in BCM using SUZUKI scan tool and security device.

s1.ptxt: Prepare all of remote controllers ready for registration.
Perform “Immobilizer Key Registration” in “Immobilizer” menu on SUZUKI scan tool. Refer to Operator’s Manual of SUZUKI scan tool immobilizer system.

attention3.ptxt: When ECM and/or ISG (K14D model) and BCM are replaced with new ones at the same time, perform “Immobilizer Key Registration” instead of “ECM Registration” or “Integrated Starter Generator (48V model) Registration” using SUZUKI scan tool and security device. Refer to Operator’s Manual of SUZUKI scan tool immobilizer system for the immobilizer registration.
